prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign-in step after adoption certificate screen: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after the adoption certificate screen so users finish pet creation before signing in.
   config: {"sign_in": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}}
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop overlay controls intro screen insertion: Insert a dedicated desktop controls intro screen after loading to demonstrate how to summon, hide, and interact with the pet.
   config: {"waiting": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "new_overlay_intro", "home_intro"]}, "new_overlay_intro": {"headline": "Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Learn how to move, minimize, and chat with your desktop pet anytime.", "layout": "centered", "button_label": "Got It"}}
2: [sign_in, redesign] Two-column layout redesign for sign-in screen: Redesign the sign-in screen into a side-by-side two-column layout separating sign-in options from pet account benefits.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet", "body": "Connect your account to keep your desktop companion synced across restarts."}}
3: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive pet personality selector screen insertion: Insert a new interactive pet personality selection screen right after picking a friend to customize pet behavior.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "new_pet_trait", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}, "new_pet_trait": {"headline": "Select Pet Personality", "body": "Choose whether your pet is energetic, relaxed, or playful on your desktop.", "layout": "stage", "button_label": "Set Personality"}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account recovery guarantee hint on sign-in screen: Add a clear hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in connects your current pet safely to your account.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Log in with your primary account to automatically bind and restore your pet data across devices."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop tip carousel component on waiting screen: Add an interactive tip carousel component on the waiting screen sharing quick desktop interaction shortcuts while loading.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "playful", "text": "Quick Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open companion settings or hide it temporarily."}]}}
6: [adoption, layout] Compact layout redesign for photo upload screen: Redesign the photo upload screen into a compact layout with streamlined controls for uploading custom images.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Upload Pet Photo", "body": "Add a photo to personalize your desktop companion."}}
7: [home, notification] Desktop readiness alert notification on waiting screen: Enable a system readiness alert notification switch on the waiting screen to inform users when their pet spawns.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will alert you as soon as your pet arrives on your desktop."}}
8: [choose_path, incentive] Starter path preview cards on story screen: Add visual choice card components to the initial story screen highlighting instant starter perks for each path.
   config: {"story": {"components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "highlight", "text": "Explore unique path bonuses and instant desktop accessories."}]}}
9: [finish, hint] Tray navigation control hint on home intro screen: Add a guidance hint on the home intro screen clarifying how to locate and control the pet via the system tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Find your pet's tray icon near your desktop clock to access controls, change settings, or summon your pet."}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption is explicitly allowed within onboarding.
Adding a new onboarding controls intro screen before home intro is allowed.
Redesigning the sign-in screen layout while preserving its function is allowed.
Inserting a new pet personality customization screen into onboarding is allowed.
Adding an informative account sync hint to the sign-in screen is allowed.
Adding an interactive tip carousel to the waiting screen is allowed.
Redesigning the photo upload screen layout while maintaining its job is allowed.
Adding notification readiness settings to the waiting screen is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions path bonuses and desktop accessories, violating the rule against mentioning gifts or free extras.
Adding guidance hints to the home intro screen is allowed.
